item.title: My 2025 Year in Books
item.description: My book consumption has experienced an uptick in seriousness and organisation in ‘25. I’ve always enjoyed reading, typically getting through ten to twenty books per year. Up to now the choice of reading matter has been rather random. I would see a review somewhere, or often just pick up a book in a bookshop. The subject matter is mostly fact rather than fiction with history, particularly of the 20th C, and even more particularly of WWII being my favorite genre. Popular science books are another favourite, as are memoirs and biographies of my favorite bands and musicians.
